content:
Sam (PMM): Need a compact battlecard for webinar follow-ups: 3 quick rebuttals per competitor bucket (cloud platforms / public LLM APIs / infra vendors), two inbound-routing rules, and a single micro-benchmark sentence we can include in the landing. Deadline: Wednesday noon.
Lina (Growth): I'll own routing + HubSpot mapping. Plan: tag leads as 'prod-critical' or 'exploratory' and route accordingly.
Omar (AE): I will paste pithy rep lines and 4 real buyer quotes. Keep responses <2 sentences.
Yvonne (Bench): Micro-bench (safe language): "Internal tests show median per-token latency for short sequences in typical configs ranges ~20-80ms; batching and caching materially reduce cost."
legal-bot: Reminder: don't publish direct % comparisons to named vendors. Use ranges and 'we observed' phrasing.
Sam (PMM): Rebuttal examples (first drafts):
- Cloud platforms: "We use on-demand endpoints" -> "We provide reserved pools with SLOs for critical routes; ask about tail-latency pain points."
- Public LLM APIs: "Simpler to call an API" -> "We give the same simplicity plus rollout controls and token-level cost visibility."
- Infra vendors: "We'll build our stack" -> "Custom stacks hide long-term ops cost; we offer private deployments + built-in ops tooling."
Lina (Growth): Routing rules (high level):
1) prod-critical & enterprise -> AE queue (priority)
2) trial & high_token_usage -> SDR + engineer review
Sam (PMM): Action items: Lina to drop HubSpot fields, Omar to paste quotes, Yvonne to finalize blurb. I'll assemble battlecard and send to Legal. :+1:
